status: Requirements recorded; no optimized candidate or native/portrait result created
scope: Two ordinary-GLB optimization derivatives from immutable224 references, with complete-chain validation required before acceptance

requirements.required: Preserve original shared world coordinates, scale, origins and attachment alignment. No per-component centering/resizing. Validate normals, winding and degenerate geometry; equal-sized triangles are not a goal.
requirements.evidence: Source/output transform and world-space attachment comparison; reassemble original-coordinate components.

requirements.required: Keep hair, body, garments, headgear, frame, lens, facial-hair and HOT roles independently addressable. Preserve separate recolor groups and frame/lens materials even if values currently match. Merge only compatible subparts inside the same control boundary. Preserve component identity/extras and COLOR_0 RGBA semantics.
requirements.evidence: Before/after semantic component/material/color-control inventory and independent hide/recolor checks. Array indices may change only with a validated role mapping; names/IDs used by consumers must remain usable.

requirements.required: Protect hair coverage, hairline/root/contact regions, garment openings/straps/hems/necklines, cap opening/bill fit, glasses placement and silhouettes. Do not remove geometry merely hidden by a selected camera/outfit. Attribute-aware simplification and explicit protected boundaries are required.
requirements.evidence: All-angle source/output views, four tones, both full-body and face framing; inspect contacts with arms/sleeves hidden and with relevant clothing/headwear toggled.

requirements.required: Regenerate each portrait color/depth pair in one versioned bake job from the same geometry/pose, camera, resolution, projection and depth convention. Existing depth maps cannot be mixed with altered geometry. No dependency on original triangle count or vertex numbering.
requirements.evidence: Atomic bake-bundle manifest with geometry/component hashes, appearance/material version, camera/projection/resolution, depth units/encoding/near-far/background convention, baker version and output hashes. Reject mismatched bundles before use.

requirements.required: Treat real lenses as a separate rendering test. Detect actual transmission/extensions rather than alphaMode alone. Preserve the source opacity1/transmission1/IOR1.25 lens behavior and independent frames. Do not hide/remove lenses, paint opacity or mark nearest-opaque output faithful. Test coverage alpha on taper separately.
requirements.evidence: Opaque/coverage-alpha/transmission classification plus visible-eyes/ordering/reflection comparisons in native3D and portrait paths. Lens portrait support remains unresolved until demonstrated or an explicit owner-approved alternative exists.

requirements.required: First outputs are ordinary GLBs with unchanged supported material behavior and floating-point geometry, no new mesh compression, quantization, instancing requirement or decoder dependency. Both native renderer and offline portrait baker must consume them before a later encoding pass.
requirements.evidence: Inspect extensions/attribute types, decode/load in both consumers, report unsupported features explicitly. Compression/quantization is a separate later decision.

requirements.required: 50,000-100,000 triangles is an exploratory target, never a pass threshold. Evaluate appearance, peak loading memory, decoded CPU/GPU geometry memory, materials/primitives/actual draw passes, responsiveness and real-phone performance together. Mesh reduction does not inherently reduce fixed-resolution decoded portrait/depth memory or engine overhead.
requirements.evidence: Per-stage measurements and matched224 source -> optimized model -> native3D -> lightweight portrait comparisons, with exact input/build/device identities.

consumer_constraints.provenance: Owner-supplied limitations; verify exact native/baker build before implementation or capability claims
consumer_constraints.portrait_prototype: Nearest opaque surface selection cannot faithfully represent transmitting lenses; geometry reduction cannot fix that rendering limitation.
consumer_constraints.offline_baker: Compression/quantization decoding is not currently supported; ordinary GLBs are mandatory for the first pass.

pipeline.pass: Pinned untouched scenes, components, material roles, choices and comparison images
Ordinary GLBs, preserved coordinates/control boundaries, all-angle and recolor comparisons, no asset-driven appearance regressions
Both platform imports and source/optimized comparisons; loading/decoded-memory/material/draw measurements
Fresh matched color/depth bundles, proper coverage handling, separate transmitting-lens result and real app workload tests

stage_policy: Record pass/fail/pending per assembly and stage. Asset-stage success never substitutes for native, portrait or phone qualification. Do not claim full-chain success while a lens/decoder/composition gap remains.
rendering_reviews: Two deliberate visual reviews minimum, source and actual exported result; any correction reopens affected checks. Preserve normals/shading discontinuities as well as positions and alpha coverage.

optimizer_policy.tool_versions: Pin versions and record exact options before running any optimizer. Do not use in-place/global defaults.
optimizer_policy.gltfpack_notes: Current docs describe node/mesh merging, material merging, extras pruning and default quantization. Evaluate preserve-name/material/extras controls (-kn/-km/-ke) and disable quantization (-noq) if gltfpack is used; these flags are not themselves proof that semantic boundaries survived.
optimizer_policy.meshoptimizer_notes: Use attribute-aware simplification with explicit border/vertex locks where applicable; protect critical seams/anchors beyond only topological mesh borders.

scope_boundaries: No224 master or published artifact changes
No new catalogue styles or profile-byte assignments
No native renderer or baker replacement silently bundled with asset optimization
Native/product work must follow its own current repository/phase rules; no phone result is inferred from browser/Blender tests
deliverables: Metrics and paired color/depth bake contract with no stale depth reuse
Native-agent handoff identifying platform/portrait/lens gates still pending
